headline: NVIDIA and Google lead the charge in AI innovation with new releases and partnerships, while Anthropic and OpenAI face challenges and controversies
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by major releases and partnerships from industry leaders like NVIDIA and Google, while Anthropic and OpenAI face challenges and controversies. NVIDIA has announced several new developments, including the public beta of NVIDIA XR AI and the expansion of the HPE AI Factory. Google has released Android 17 with new multitasking features and expanded Gemini features. Meanwhile, Anthropic is facing a feud with the Trump administration, and OpenAI is losing billions of dollars a year. These developments highlight the rapidly evolving AI landscape and the complex challenges and opportunities that come with it.

new_models.summary: NVIDIA XR AI is now available in public beta, giving developers a framework for building multimodal AI agents for AR glasses and XR devices.
